reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: A sustainability-linked loan ("SLL") of up to PLN 600 million to CCC S.A. ("Borrower", "Company") one of the largest and fastest growing European footwear and apparel retail chains present predominantly in CEE. The SLL will be provided for the benfit of CCC Business Unit which includes core CCC footwear business and HalfPrice discount apparel store chain. The EBRD will act as a co-lender alongside Polish commercial banks in a syndicate financing of up to PLN 3.66 billion. The project will support Company's growth in selected channels in Poland and other CEE markets, including through investments into new sustainable warehouse capacity, while broadening access to livelihood opportunities for people with disabilities within Poland's labour market.
